name: undo-redo-buttons
title: Undo and redo buttons
description: The undo and redo pair of any editor: dimmed when there is nothing to step through, the next step named in the tooltip, and the shortcuts bound for you.
docs: You own the history: keep it in a reducer or your editor and wire onUndo and onRedo. Pass the next step as undoLabel ("Undo: Move layer"); it becomes the tooltip and what a screen reader hears afterwards. The keys are ignored inside fields; pass scope to listen only inside an editor.
